q: What is transition finance, and could a steel or cement MSME be ready for it?
title: Transition finance for hard-to-abate MSMEs
short: Transition finance supports companies in heavy emitting sectors to cut emissions over time, rather than only funding activities that are already green. Readiness means a measured baseline, a credible plan with milestones, and records that show progress.
audience: MSMEs in steel, cement, ceramics, foundry and chemicals

ul: A baseline from real bills and production.
A plan: fuel switch, efficiency, electrification, with dates.

p: Without a measured starting point, progress cannot be shown, so most frameworks start there.
Definitions differ between lenders and taxonomies, and none guarantees funding.

senseible: Senseible turns bills and fuel invoices into a dated, traceable emissions record, the kind of evidence lenders may ask for. Lenders decide, and financing is never guaranteed.

sources.label: Loan Market Association, green and sustainability-linked loan principles
